candidates.name: Ecthyma gangrenosum
support_spans: Seventeen days after her last day of chemotherapy, while neutropenic, she became febrile
Several vesicles with an erythematous base were observed on the lower back and left thigh
candidates.why: The patient's presentation of vesicles with an erythematous base, particularly in the context of neutropenia and recent chemotherapy, is consistent with Ecthyma gangrenosum

candidates.name: Disseminated herpes simplex virus infection
support_spans: Seventeen days after her last day of chemotherapy, while neutropenic, she became febrile
Several vesicles with an erythematous base were observed on the lower back and left thigh
contradict_spans: PCR testing for herpes simplex virus (HSV) and varicella zoster virus (VZV) were negative
candidates.why: The patient's presentation of vesicles with an erythematous base could be consistent with a disseminated herpes simplex virus infection, but PCR testing was negative

candidates.name: Pseudomonas aeruginosa sepsis
support_spans: Seventeen days after her last day of chemotherapy, while neutropenic, she became febrile
Patient had an indwelling catheter
candidates.why: The patient's neutropenia and indwelling catheter increase the risk of Pseudomonas aeruginosa sepsis, which can cause Ecthyma gangrenosum

candidates.name: Bacteremia due to gram-negative rods
support_spans: Gram stain revealed numerous gram-variable rods in the necrotic epidermis and dermis
candidates.why: The presence of gram-variable rods in the necrotic epidermis and dermis suggests bacteremia due to gram-negative rods

candidates.name: Pseudomonas aeruginosa infection
support_spans: Gram stain revealed numerous gram-variable rods in the necrotic epidermis and dermis
candidates.why: The Gram stain result is decisive in identifying the presence of gram-variable rods, which is consistent with Pseudomonas aeruginosa infection

candidates.name: Ecthyma gangrenosum due to Pseudomonas aeruginosa
support_spans: Hematoxylin-eosin stain showed focal epidermal and subepidermal necrosis with numerous filamentous bacilli with septa
candidates.why: The histopathology result is decisive in identifying the characteristic features of Ecthyma gangrenosum due to Pseudomonas aeruginosa
